# I need to understand how the daily view's AI reflection (2026-03-19 06:39Z)

_**User**_

I need to understand how the daily view's AI reflection works in this Electron app. Specifically:

2. In `src/renderer/src/services/ai.ts`, find the `buildReflectionSystemPrompt` function and understand what it does.
